messages:
maya: Hey team — quick ask: can we get temporary access to raw LLM request/response snapshots for a customer regression? Need ~1 hour of traces for a single customer id to debug hallucination.
jonathan: what's the scope? full bodies, headers, token streams?
luis: only need request/response bodies and model metadata. must redact tokens and emails.
maya: yes, just for customer_id=12345, one-off. retention 1h, access for me + luis + eng oncall.
sec-bot: FYI: default policy prohibits storing raw prompts. Need approval + audit trail. Can you list justification + ticket?
maya: created INC-7892 with details, link: https://tickets.internal/INC-7892
jonathan: ok — security conditions I'd expect:
- ephemeral S3 bucket with strict allowlist
- objects encrypted via KMS
- presigned URLs expire in 1h
- audit log entry for every download
- redact tokens (Authorization, X-Api-Key) and hash user_id
luis: for redaction I can run server-side scrub before upload. sample scrub:
```
def scrub_payload(p):
    p['prompt']=re.sub(r"(\\b\\w+@\\w+\\.\\w+\\b)", "<email>", p.get('prompt',''))
    p['prompt']=re.sub(r"(^|\\s)(sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,})", " <redacted_token>", p['prompt'])
    p['user_id']=hashlib.sha256(p.get('user_id','').encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
    return p
```
jonathan: looks fine. Also require that stored objects are single-customer and labeled with ticket id.
sec-bot: Approval granted conditionally. Please file a short runbook section in the ticket describing who can access and TTL. Access will be via IAM role assumption (duration 1h). Audit-bot will announce downloads.
maya: will do. Thank you :thumbsup:
audit-bot: Download event recorded: INC-7892 maya assumed-role:eng-debug for 1h :lock:
luis: grabbing samples now. I'll post sanitized excerpts in the ticket, not in Slack.
maya: closing loop — samples deleted from bucket at 2026-03-18T15:22:00Z per TTL.
jonathan: confirmed deletion and audit entries present. all good.
